body:
## Pull request overview

This PR improves the Grid/DataTable UX toward an Airtable-style experience by making the primary field behave like a record link, enhancing record detail rendering, adding header/row affordances (expand + context menu), and extending i18n coverage for grid/table-related strings.

**Changes:**
- Auto-link the first (primary) grid column to record detail and standardize empty-value display styling.
- Replace the record detail “key/value dump” with a form-like panel layout (regular vs system fields) and add richer value formatting.
- Add DataTable row-hover expand affordance + header right-click context menu; extend locale packs and add tests/roadmap entries.

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 15 out of 16 changed files in this pull request and generated 10 comments.

<details>
<summary>Show a summary per file</summary>

| File | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| pnpm-lock.yaml | Updates lockfile (currently drops hotcrm workspace importers). |
| packages/plugin-grid/src/ObjectGrid.tsx | Implements primary-field auto-link, new empty-value indicator, and form-based record detail renderer. |
| packages/plugin-grid/src/__tests__/airtable-style.test.tsx | Adds tests for primary-field auto-link / empty display and a placeholder record-detail test. |
| packages/components/src/renderers/complex/data-table.tsx | Adds row-hover expand button and column-header context menu (sort/hide). |
| packages/components/src/renderers/complex/__tests__/data-table-airtable-ux.test.tsx | New tests for expand button, context menu, and hide column behavior. |
| packages/i18n/src/locales/{en,zh,ar,de,es,fr,ja,ko,pt,ru}.ts | Adds `grid.*` and `table.hideColumn/freezeColumn/unfreezeColumn` keys across locales. |
| ROADMAP.md | Marks the new Airtable-style UX items as completed. |
</details>


<details>
<summary>Files not reviewed (1)</summary>

* **pnpm-lock.yaml**: Language not supported
</details>

`(isPrimaryField && col.action)` can never be true because `isPrimaryField` is defined as `... && !col.action`. This makes the condition misleading/dead code. Simplify the condition (e.g., keep only `col.link && col.action`) or adjust the primary-field predicate if you intended to support a combined primary-field+action case.
```suggestion
              if (col.link && col.action) {
```

The expand-button tooltip text `Open record` is hardcoded. Since i18n keys include `grid.openRecord`, consider using the translation hook so the tooltip localizes consistently.
```suggestion
                              title={t('grid.openRecord')}
```

Context menu labels are hardcoded (e.g. `Sort ascending/descending`, `Hide column`). Since i18n keys exist (`table.sortAsc`, `table.sortDesc`, `table.hideColumn`), consider using the translation hook here instead of string literals so the menu localizes correctly.

pnpm-workspace.yaml still includes `examples/hotcrm/packages/*`, but this lockfile update removes all `examples/hotcrm/packages/...` importers. If the hotcrm submodule is checked out (as in CI), `pnpm install` will regenerate the lockfile and the repo will drift. Regenerate pnpm-lock.yaml with the submodule present, or remove/update the workspace globs if hotcrm is intentionally excluded.

The record detail panel introduces new user-facing strings (`Empty`, `Yes`/`No`) as literals. Since i18n keys exist for `common.yes`/`common.no`, consider using the translation hook here (and add a key for the empty-state label) so the detail panel is localizable like the rest of the UI.

The detail panel section header label `System` is hardcoded. There is already an i18n key (`console.system`) that matches this label; using i18n here would keep the detail panel consistent with the newly added locale coverage.

The new `renderRecordDetail` formatting logic (system-field split, empty-state label, boolean badges, date detection) is not exercised by tests right now. Adding an interaction test that opens a record and asserts these render branches would prevent regressions.

`const onRowClick = vi.fn();` is declared but never used in this test, and the test doesn’t assert that the record detail panel actually renders. Either remove the unused variable or use it (e.g., click the primary field, verify the drawer content/`record-detail-panel` test id) so this test covers the new behavior.

The context menu is positioned directly at `clientX/clientY` without viewport clamping, so it can render off-screen near the right/bottom edges. Consider clamping the computed `left/top` based on menu size + `window.innerWidth/innerHeight` (or using a popover/portal utility that handles collision).
```suggestion
          style={{
            left:
              typeof window !== 'undefined'
                ? Math.max(
                    0,
                    Math.min(contextMenu.x, window.innerWidth - 200)
                  )
                : contextMenu.x,
            top:
              typeof window !== 'undefined'
                ? Math.max(
                    0,
                    Math.min(contextMenu.y, window.innerHeight - 200)
                  )
                : contextMenu.y,
          }}
```
